run:ci.yml:pr.why: light checks; the pull request waits on this

run:ci.yml:pr-wide.why: graphty-element src/ or global inputs changed

run:release.yml:full.why: full run plus the release lanes

task:graphty:build.why: 1m23s before the Sentry regression, 60-63 s after the fix (uncached)

ttg:full.why: red full run to the next green one

bytes:lfs.why: Team allowance 250 GiB, a hard block

bytes:actions-cache.why: 10 GB limit; LRU eviction above it

job:ci.yml:Cache hygiene.why: one list call and a delete per superseded key

cache:codeql-*.why: CodeQL overlay base database, 1.3 GB for javascript, one per master push

cache:lfs-*.why: one project's LFS baselines (graphty 0.5 GB), a key per pull request that changes them

cache:node-cache-*.why: pnpm store, 0.32 GB, a key per lockfile

cache:test-durations-*.why: a key per shard per run, KB each
